name: Celina
seo_title: Celina, TX Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 4 Events
seo_description: Celina kids' Christmas: Christmas on the Square with a 30 foot tree, Christmas at Old Celina Park, Jingle Bell Breakfast and Del Webb Lights.
lede: The story of Christmas in Celina starts in 1879, when the town was founded, and in 1902, when it moved a mile north to meet the railroad, and today it centers on Christmas on the Square, where a 30 foot tree is lit on the historic downtown square. Celina has 4 events this season, led by Christmas on the Square on Wednesday, December 2, 2026.
sections: Founded in 1879, moved to the railroad in 1902

Celina was established in 1879 and named by John T. Mulkey for his native town of Celina, Tennessee. When the St. Louis, San Francisco and Texas Railway reached the area in 1902, the town moved to its present location one mile north of the original site. It was incorporated in 1907, and in 1915 it had the first road in Collin County built exclusively for automobiles, Celina Pike, along with two banks, a newspaper and a municipal water works. The Handbook of Texas counts 1,861 residents in 2000, 6,028 in 2010, 16,739 in 2020 and 23,811 in 2021.

The City of Celina calls Christmas on the Square one of its signature annual events. In 2026 it is Wednesday, December 2, from 5 to 9 pm on Celina's Downtown Square, presented by Specialty Land Services and free. Local choirs and dance studios perform on the REX Real Estate Stage from 5 pm, kids can visit Santa's Workshop and meet reindeer, and a 30 foot Christmas tree sponsored by Sobha Realty is lit at 8 pm. The city runs a free park and ride from Celina High School from 5 to 10 pm. In 2026 Celina Main Street was named an Accredited Main Street America program, one of 838 nationwide.
More Celina Christmas, and trains nearby

Celina's other 2026 events spread across town. Portrait Church holds Christmas at Old Celina Park, 12670 FM 423, on Saturday, December 12, with a candlelight service from 5 to 5:45 pm and a free festival from 6 to 8:30 pm with snow tubing and a petting zoo. That morning, Celina Parks and Recreation serves a Jingle Bell Breakfast from 9 to 11 am at the Ralph O'Dell Senior Center, for $20 per family of up to four. Del Webb Lights at Legacy Hills, a free drive through show of nearly 40,000 lights, runs nightly from December 1 to 31. For trains, see Frisco's Museum of the American Railroad.

kidfact: Celina is named after a town in Tennessee, and in 1915 it built the first road in Collin County just for cars, called Celina Pike.
faq: How did Celina get its name?

John T. Mulkey named Celina for his native town of Celina, Tennessee. The Texas town was established in 1879 in northwestern Collin County and moved to its present location one mile north in 1902, when the St. Louis, San Francisco and Texas Railway reached the area, according to the Handbook of Texas.

Celina moved one mile north of its original site when the St. Louis, San Francisco and Texas Railway reached the area in 1902, so that the town would sit by the tracks. The Handbook of Texas says Celina was incorporated in 1907 and had two banks, a newspaper and a municipal water works by 1915.

Celina Pike was the first road in Collin County built exclusively for automobiles, completed in 1915, according to the Handbook of Texas. At that time Celina also had two banks, a newspaper and a municipal water works. Today the town is far larger, at 16,739 people in 2020 and 23,811 in 2021.
When is Christmas on the Square in Celina?

Wednesday, December 2, 2026, from 5 to 9 pm on Celina's Downtown Square, presented by Specialty Land Services. It is free and family friendly, with a 30 foot tree lit at 8 pm. The city runs a free park and ride from Celina High School from 5 to 10 pm.
Can kids meet Santa in Celina?

Yes. At Christmas on the Square on December 2, kids can visit Santa's Workshop, take photos with Santa, eat cookies with the elves, meet Santa's reindeer and climb into Santa's sleigh. The city's news post calls the event free. Christmas at Old Celina Park on December 12 also has Santa photo spots.
